title: The Big 4 departments, explained with Ledger in under 2 minutes
summary: One juice company meets audit, tax, deals and consulting at a Big 4 firm, then learns why the same firm cannot audit it and install its systems, ending on a four-column board with real logos.

beats.label: title
beats.voice: The Big 4 departments, explained with Ledger in under 2 minutes
beats.visual: Title card on steps: the four official logos on white chips pop in one by one (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) as the voice reaches the title; Ledger in a suit waves in the middle

beats.label: intro
beats.voice: First, the Big 4 are Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG, and each one sells four similar kinds of work to companies
beats.visual: Four office towers rise left to right; each logo chip lands on its tower as its name is said; four labelled doors open at the base of each tower

beats.label: intro
beats.voice: So let's imagine one client, a juice company called Sunny Press, and follow its year
beats.visual: A juice stand with an orange logo slides in; a calendar page flips through four seasons; Ledger as the owner holds a juice bottle

beats.label: dept
beats.voice: First, the auditors check the accounts of Sunny Press, and then they sign an audit opinion saying the numbers are fairly stated
beats.visual: Ledger auditor in a suit and glasses ticks rows on a ledger book at the word checks; a document labelled AUDIT OPINION slides out and a green stamp lands on it at the word sign

beats.label: compare
beats.voice: This department is called Audit and Assurance at Deloitte and KPMG, and Assurance at PwC and EY
beats.visual: Name chips with logos drop under the document, one per firm at the word naming it

beats.label: dept
beats.voice: Then the tax team prepares the company's tax returns and advises on how to plan its taxes in each country
beats.visual: Ledger tax adviser at a desk with a calculator; a form labelled TAX RETURN gets a stamp at the word prepares; a small map with two flags (two countries) lights up at the word country

beats.label: dept
beats.voice: Next, Sunny Press wants to buy a smaller juice brand, so the deals team investigates that company and writes a due diligence report
beats.visual: A small juice stand appears at right with a price tag; Ledger deal adviser holds a magnifying glass over it at the word investigates; a report with a checklist slides out at the word writes

beats.label: dept
beats.voice: After that, the consulting team installs a new sales system, so Sunny Press can track every order
beats.visual: Ledger consultant in a hoodie plugs a laptop screen into a big dashboard; orders as small boxes flow into the dashboard at the words every order

beats.label: compare
beats.voice: But here is the catch, because the same firm cannot do all of this for one client
beats.visual: All four documents sit in a row; a red cross appears over the audit opinion and the system together at the word cannot

beats.label: compare
beats.voice: If a firm audits a public company, US rules stop it from also designing that company's financial systems, because it would be auditing its own work
beats.visual: Ledger auditor looks at a system diagram he built himself, a mirror loop arrow points from the auditor back to the system at the words own work; a balance scale tips

beats.label: compare
beats.voice: So Sunny Press hires one firm to audit it and a different firm to install the system
beats.visual: Two towers with different logo chips; each Ledger shakes hands with the owner from its own side

beats.label: payoff
beats.voice: Finally, here is the summary board, with audit, tax, deals and consulting, and the work each one hands over
beats.visual: A board with four columns fills in; each column gets its department icon and Ledger outfit at the word naming it

beats.label: payoff
beats.voice: So audit gives an opinion, tax gives returns and advice, deals gives a diligence report, and consulting gives a working system
beats.visual: Each work product document lands under its column at the word naming it, with a tick

beats.label: payoff
beats.voice: The names differ by firm, but these four jobs stay the same
beats.visual: Four small logo rows sweep across the board; dotted lines show Deals and Consulting grouped under Advisory at KPMG and PwC, and listed separately at EY

beats.label: cta
beats.voice: To climb your own career ladder, learn technical business concepts at Edlintics
beats.visual: Standard ladder-reel closing scene with all Ledgers on the steps

caption:
What do the Big 4 actually do all day?

Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG each sell four similar kinds of work. Audit checks the accounts and gives an audit opinion, tax prepares returns and advises on tax planning, deals investigates a company before it is bought, and consulting installs systems that change how a business runs

But one firm cannot do everything for one client, because an auditor must stay independent and must not audit its own work

Which of these four departments would you want to see from the inside?
